items.body: A later empty start domain can erase an earlier evaluated arithmetic fault. Extend the existing start-overflow control with a second field, `#[starts(1..0)] spare: i8`. The invalid first range receives a fallback value, but the second range makes the conjoined Init unsatisfiable. Consequently, ArithmeticSafe has no reachable failure, although native `starts()` evaluates—and fails on—the first endpoint before entering the second loop.
items.suggestion: Emit an initialization-error branch that remains reachable independently of subsequent start domains. Preserve field-order evaluation so an earlier empty domain still skips later expressions. Add controls for both orders.
items.title: A later empty start domain can erase an earlier evaluated arithmetic fault
